text:
Eli: Heads-up — planning a 30–45m design review for the new API/SDK/Console changes (session multiplexing prototype). Need to lock a slot next week. Please react: ✅ = can attend, 🕓 = prefer afternoon, or reply with your times. I’ll send pre-read links once we pick a slot.

Maya: ✅ count me in. Prefer Tue afternoon (3pm PT) or Wed morning.

Jin: 🕓 Tue afternoon might be rough — I have a rollout sync at 3:30. Can we aim Wed 10am PT? Also add telemetry/metrics section to pre-read.

Priya: Wed 10am PT works for me. Two asks for the pre-read: 1) API contract example (request/response/errors) 2) Console mock for the new settings flow. Also flagging the SDK PR that needs a quick review: #234 — can someone pre-lint?

Eli: Noted. Plan for Wed 10am PT then unless any blockers. I can own the console mocks, Priya can owner the API contract doc, Jin you take telemetry, Maya can drive SDK pre-review?

Maya: I can do SDK pre-review — will comment on #234 by EOD Monday.

Jin: I’ll paste a minimal pre-read checklist here (short):

```
- One-paragraph problem statement + goals
- API contract sample (curl + JSON response)
- Error matrix (client vs server errors)
- Telemetry points + SLI/alerts to consider
- Console mock screenshots (desktop + mobile)
- SDK usage example + known breaking changes
- Open questions / decision points (max 6)
```

Priya: Perfect. I’ll draft the API sample and error matrix and drop into the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/session-mux/pre-read (placeholder).

OncallBot: FYI — Incident window scheduled Tue 16:00–17:00 PT in cluster-3; any Tue 3pm–4:30pm slot will likely clash if oncall needs to join.

Eli: Good catch @OncallBot — that rules out Tue 3pm. Wed 10am it is.

Maya: Can we keep the agenda tight? Suggested 35m: 10m context + 10m API/SDK review + 10m console mocks + 5m action items/owners.

Jin: +1 to the agenda. I’ll prepare telemetry slides (two bullets + a sample query).

Priya: I’ll upload API samples by Monday noon.

Eli: I’ll create the calendar invite (Wed 10am PT, 35m) and attach the pre-read link and a checklist. Please add any must-have attendees.

Maya: tagging product: @Maya please add @Tom if he wants to weigh in on rollout? (small ping)

Eli: Added Tom and Design in the invite. If anyone needs a different timezone friendly time (APAC), say so and we’ll record.

Maya: Recording would be great — +1.

Priya: Quick follow-up — can we include a short code snippet demonstrating auth changes? I’ll add one inline in the doc.

Eli: Please do. Final ask: keep pre-read under 2 pages so reviewers actually skim. :thumbsup:

Maya: ✅ thanks — will keep it concise.

Eli: Thanks everyone — I’ll post the invite and the pre-read link once Priya and Jin drop their pieces.

(THREAD CLOSED)
